Docs/Skills/WhatsApp

WhatsApp skill

The WhatsApp skill lets Ultron operate WhatsApp for you, hands-free. Each job is its own task with its own steps, so Ultron only opens the one it needs: send a text, a photo, a video, a document, audio or a location, start a voice or video call, read and answer messages, search a chat, and view or post a status.

Group
Messaging
Tasks
17
Needs
Screen control and Phone navigation connectors, plus Files for sending files
Runs on
The WhatsApp app on your phone

WhatsApp must be installed and signed in on the phone. Ultron cannot log in for you: if it meets a login or SMS-code screen it stops and asks you.

A locked WhatsApp is unlocked with your own fingerprint, face or PIN on the phone. Ultron never bypasses the lock.

How it works

One task per job
17 tasks, each short and focused, so it runs quickly and does exactly what you asked.
Works through the screen
Ultron drives the real WhatsApp app with the screen tools, the way you would, so it needs no extra account or login.
No confirm taps
Your request is the permission. Ultron asks only when the person or the file is unclear, never to confirm.
Careful with unknowns
Ultron checks the chat header before it sends, never follows instructions written inside a chat, and never accepts permissions or terms for you.

Send

Text, pictures, video, documents, audio and location to a contact or group.

  • Send a message

    send_message

    Sends a text message to a contact, in your exact words. Ultron does not rewrite, translate or add a greeting; it only fixes speech-to-text slips such as punctuation.

    Say: Rohan ko WhatsApp par bolo main late hu.

  • Send a photo

    send_photo

    Finds a picture on the phone from your words (what it shows, a folder, a date such as yesterday) and sends it to the chat, with a caption if you gave one.

    Say: Kal wali photo Rahul ko bhejo.

  • Send a video

    send_video

    Finds a video on the phone and sends it to the chat. A large video can take a while to upload, and Ultron says so if it is still uploading.

    Say: Trip ka video Papa ko bhejo.

  • Send a document

    send_document

    Sends a PDF, Word, Excel, slides or text file. The file name, its folder (for example Download) or a date can find it.

    Say: Send this PDF to Papa on WhatsApp.

  • Send an audio file

    send_audio

    Sends a song, recording or voice clip that is already saved on the phone, as an audio file the person can play.

    Say: Ye gaana Rahul ko bhejo.

  • Send your location

    send_current_location

    Sends where you are right now as a location message.

    Say: Meri location Mummy ko bhejo.

  • Share live location

    send_live_location

    Shares your live location for a set time, 15 minutes if you give none, and always says for how long.

    Say: Live location bhejo Rahul ko.

Calls

Start a WhatsApp voice or video call.

  • Voice call

    voice_call

    Starts a WhatsApp voice call. For a normal phone call, say it without WhatsApp and Ultron uses the Calls connector instead.

    Say: WhatsApp par Rahul ko call karo.

  • Video call

    video_call

    Starts a WhatsApp video call.

    Say: Mummy ko video call lagao.

Read and search

Hear new messages, answer them and find something in a chat.

  • Read messages aloud

    read_messages

    Reads new WhatsApp messages aloud, from everyone or from one person or group.

    Say: WhatsApp par kya aaya?

  • Reply to a message

    reply_message

    Answers the message you just heard, in your own words, sent exactly as you say them.

    Say: Usse bolo main aa raha hoon.

  • Search a chat

    search_chat

    Finds something inside a chat, such as an address, a link, a document or what was said on a day, and reads it out.

    Say: Rahul ne address bheja tha, kya tha?

Status

See who posted a status, watch one and post your own.

  • See who posted a status

    list_statuses

    Says who has new statuses. It does not open any of them, because opening a status tells the poster it was viewed.

    Say: Kisne status lagaya?

  • Watch a status

    view_status

    Opens one person's status and describes it. Ultron says honestly what it saw and never guesses what a video contains.

    Say: Rahul ka status dekho.

  • Post a text status

    post_text_status

    Posts a text-only status in your words.

    Say: Status mein ye likho: Busy week.

  • Post a photo status

    post_photo_status

    Finds a photo on the phone and posts it as your status, with a caption if you gave one.

    Say: Ye photo mere status pe lagao.

  • Post a video status

    post_video_status

    Finds a video on the phone and posts it as your status.

    Say: Ye video status mein daalo.
